body:
## Pull request overview Updates CRD wording to show “Optional Extensions” (instead of “Option Extensions”) and introduces Ruff-based Python linting/formatting with related refactors and config updates. **Changes:** - Update CRD template to use a concise presence string (`to_s_concise`) so “Optional Extensions” is displayed. - Reformat/refactor multiple Python utilities (typing cleanups, minor safety improvements like avoiding mutable default args). - Replace Black/pyupgrade with Ruff (adds `pyproject.toml`, updates pre-commit hooks, adds Ruff dependency), and bump dev container tag. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 12 out of 14 changed files in this pull request and generated 4 comments.
Show a summary per file | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | tools/ruby-gems/udb/python/yaml_resolver.py | Python cleanup/refactors (imports, style, safer default arg). | | tools/python/udb.py | Adds typing, safer YAML handling, and avoids repeated `kinds` membership checks. | | tools/python/profile_extensions.py | Minor type hinting and formatting-only changes. | | tools/mcp_gen_server/server.py | Typing modernization + minor exception-handling refactors and formatting. | | requirements.txt | Adds `ruff` dependency pin. | | pyproject.toml | Adds Ruff configuration (lint + format). | | bin/.container-tag | Bumps container tag from `0.15` to `0.16`. | | backends/proc_crd/templates/proc_crd.adoc.erb | Uses `to_s_concise` to render “Optional Extensions” text/header. | | backends/generators/sverilog/sverilog_generator.py | Import ordering + minor logging/style tweaks. | | backends/generators/generator.py | Formatting tweaks; fixes an error-message path when a file is missing. | | backends/generators/c_header/generate_encoding.py | Import cleanup + formatting changes. | | backends/generators/Go/go_generator.py | Formatting tweaks and minor string formatting cleanup. | | .vscode/extensions.json | Recommends the Ruff VS Code extension. | | .pre-commit-config.yaml | Replaces Black/pyupgrade hooks with Ruff check/format hooks. |
